headline: Issued certificate of compliance for 55 Abbott Street and continued six wetland hearings to May 19, 2026
summary: The Commission reviewed certificates of compliance, several Notices of Intent for construction projects near wetlands, and enforcement matters at properties on Hart Street, Elliott Street, and Bay View Avenue. Most hearings were continued to May 19, 2026, after site walks were scheduled, and enforcement orders were amended to require restoration plans. The Commission also approved a certificate of compliance, a determination of applicability, and the April 7, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved a Complete Certificate of Compliance for 55 Abbott Street, DEP File #5-1008, including perpetual conditions #35-38, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 206 Greenwood Avenue, DEP File #5-1469, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 55 Abbott Street, DEP File #5-1468, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 212 Common Lane, DEP File #5-1467, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 7 Hathaway Avenue, DEP File #5-1466, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 5 Orchard Street, No DEP File # as of posting, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 13 Butterworth Road, DEP File #5-1465, to May 19, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the Request for Determination of Applicability for 228 Common Lane to May 19, 2026, 4-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 51 Brimbal Avenue, 4-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 140 Hart Street to accept the restoration plan with specified conditions, 4-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 181 Elliott Street to require a formal restoration plan by May 12, 2026, and attendance at the May 19, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue to require a Notice of Intent filed by July 14, 2026, for dune fencing, 4-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of April 7, 2026, as submitted, 4-0.
